title: You’re already one of us / Street posters
slide_intent: Connect a welcoming message with repeated identity cues so passersby can recognize both the host and the invitation.
strategic_value: Alternating light and dark posters can give Twitch variety while retaining the same wordmark and inclusive message.
demonstration: A street photograph shows a repeated two-row poster installation with large gradient-backed Twitch signatures and a short invitation between them.
practical_value: Compare how an identity repeats across adjacent panels without requiring every panel to use the same background.

content_islands.name: Poster installation
content_islands.spec: Fill the wall with alternating pale and black panels, each using large wordmarks with colored depth.

content_islands.name: Invitation and setting
content_islands.spec: Keep the short invitation between signatures and preserve the street, poles and roofline that establish scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph places repeated identity posters in a street environment.
reference_purposes.Expression: Black and pale panels share the white angular wordmark and multicolor depth.
